name: Mobile Development
goal: The app in somebody’s pocket, from the first screen to the store. The trunk is the same for everyone — how the web works, version control, and the fundamentals that separate a mobile app from a program with a window — and then you choose the platform: Android with Kotlin, iOS with Swift, or both at once with React Native. It converges again on the part nobody escapes: data on the device, testing and publishing. Based on the community Android and iOS roadmaps at roadmap.sh.

courses.note: The three paths come back together: what follows is the same for all of them.
